examined_formations.title: CHINA_CHONGQING_BUILDING_QUALITY_TESTING_COMPLETED_100_PERCENT_CONTROL_WITH_MODEST_EQUITY_COST_POSITIVE_POST_PURCHASE_RESULTS_BUT_GENERIC_CASHFLOW_AND_EXPLICIT_66_PERSON_LAB_FIELD_SERVICE_DESIGN
observed_actor_state_change_evidence: Lets Holdings completed a 100% cash acquisition of Chongqing Gaoxin Zhuotai Building Engineering Quality Testing Co., Ltd. on 2026-03-31; the purchase date is the equity-delivery date.
The 2026 half-year acquisition table reports purchase-date-to-period-end revenue RMB4,481,382.76, net profit RMB673,409.92 and generic cash flow RMB2,158,139.69.
The acquisition cost is RMB7,063,674.47 and the target entered the buyer's consolidation scope after the completed transfer.
objective_endowment_or_underuse_evidence: A Chongqing High-tech Zone environmental-impact filing for the same company's operating laboratory records project investment of RMB15 million, 3,679.89 square meters, about 600 instruments, 140 testing items / 927 parameters and about 90,000 test groups per year.
The same official operating-design packet records labor quota of 66 people, one 8-hour shift and 300 operating days per year.
The EIA explicitly describes on-site testing for exterior insulation, foundations, main structures, indoor environment, municipal roads/bridges and steel structures in addition to laboratory testing.
observed_behavior_or_workaround_evidence: The acquirer bought the whole company rather than a passive minority interest, and the target continued earning external testing revenue after control changed.
The operating capability is credentialed testing infrastructure plus staff and field measurement, not merely a shell or transferable software license.
contradiction_or_partial_flow_evidence: The acquisition accounting metric is labeled only cash flow, not operating cash flow; Scan 115 therefore does not upgrade RMB2.1581 million to explicit positive OCF.

The government EIA's 66-person labor design is from the laboratory project filing rather than a 2026 transfer-date HR ledger; it is strong evidence that the operating model is not intrinsically zero/one-person, but current exact FTE remains unrefreshed.

The RMB7.06 million equity cost is not the total usable-capital requirement: the operating laboratory itself was filed at RMB15 million investment and uses hundreds of instruments, while the purchase-date balance sheet also carries material receivables and payables.
Core value delivery includes laboratory work and project-site inspection by technical personnel, so machine-only delivery is not evidenced.
economic_signal: 100% acquisition cost RMB7.0637 million; control completed 2026-03-31.
Purchase-date-to-period-end revenue RMB4.4814 million and net profit RMB0.6734 million.
Generic post-purchase cash flow RMB2.1581 million, not explicitly OCF.
Official laboratory filing: RMB15 million project investment and 66-person labor quota.
exact_incumbent_and_control_surface_pref: The control surface is an accredited engineering-quality testing business combining physical laboratory assets, instruments and field inspection.
Automation can assist readings/reporting, but the evidence does not show a unique external machine-callable transaction/action rail independent of credentialed laboratory and site work.
A generic agent does not replace accreditation/instrumentation, yet that distinctiveness is coupled to recurring human and physical delivery.

examined_formations.title: CHINA_HANGZHOU_HMI_AUDIO_SOC_COMPLETED_CONTROL_WITH_POSITIVE_POST_PURCHASE_REVENUE_PROFIT_AND_EXPLICIT_OPERATING_CASHFLOW_BUT_HIGH_CONTROL_CAPITAL_AND_UNCLOSED_CURRENT_LOW_FTE
observed_actor_state_change_evidence: GreatStar acquired incremental equity in Hangzhou Nano IC Technology Co., Ltd. and control transferred on 2025-07-14; after the transaction GreatStar held 51%.
The 2025 annual acquisition table reports accounting acquisition cost RMB138.3447 million and explicitly states control transfer as the purchase-date basis.

Purchase-date-to-year-end revenue was RMB73.7647 million, net profit RMB4.6009 million and operating-activity net cash inflow RMB7.3001 million; investment and financing cashflow are reported separately.
objective_endowment_or_underuse_evidence: The target focuses on advanced HMI and intelligent-audio integrated circuits and overall solutions, with RF-SoC and Audio MCU/DSP/SoC products plus algorithms, protocols, middleware, applications and cloud-side data processing.
The target's current website states 40+ intellectual-property items, 60+ customers and 20+ chip products.

Purchase-date accounting shows material cash and financial assets but also substantial intangible value and inventory; the control asset is specialized semiconductor IP and product/customer organization rather than a passive financial shell.
observed_behavior_or_workaround_evidence: The buyer increased from a non-controlling position to 51% control and the same target continued producing external revenue, profit and explicitly positive operating cashflow after control changed.
This is the strongest Scan 115 financial-control packet because OCF is explicitly separated from investment and financing cash flows.
contradiction_or_partial_flow_evidence: Positive explicit post-transfer OCF is proven, but the accounting control cost is RMB138.3447 million, far outside bounded small-operator capital.
Current exact target FTE or replacement-service cost is not disclosed in the acquisition packet; therefore the low-labor floor remains UNKNOWN rather than passed.

Current public company materials describe an active HMI/audio IC and integrated-solution organization, and current recruiting evidence shows multiple IC design/verification/embedded/algorithm roles; this is consistent with recurring specialized engineering but is not used as a substitute for an audited current FTE count.

A historical public-transfer statement reported 44 employees in 2016, 25 in R&D; that historical packet establishes the organization has long embodied expert labor but is not treated as current headcount.
economic_signal: Purchase-date-to-year-end revenue RMB73.7647 million; net profit RMB4.6009 million.
Explicit operating-activity net cash inflow RMB7.3001 million.
exact_incumbent_and_control_surface_pref: The distinctive asset is specialized semiconductor IP plus system solution capability, not a generic agent wrapper.
That specialization does not satisfy founder-lightness because current replacement engineering cost and FTE are not closed and chip/software development remains expert work.
No evidence shows a reusable external settlement/action rail separable from the semiconductor product organization.

examined_formations.title: CHINA_GUANGDONG_COMMERCIAL_CLEANING_EQUIPMENT_COMPLETED_CONTROL_WITH_POST_CONTROL_POSITIVE_REVENUE_PROFIT_BUT_TARGET_LEVEL_NEGATIVE_OPERATING_CASHFLOW_AND_SERVICE_NETWORK_LABOR
observed_actor_state_change_evidence: Nanhua Instruments completed the additional acquisition of Gadlee shares in October 2025; with the prior 15% stake, it held 54.4745%, obtained actual operating/financial control and consolidated Gadlee from 2025-11-01.
The 2025 acquisition accounting records cash consideration RMB76.3832 million, prior stake fair value RMB29.0250 million and total combination cost RMB105.4082 million.

Nanhua's 2026 half-year important non-wholly-owned subsidiary table reports Gadlee target-level revenue RMB52.9509 million, net profit RMB1.2366 million and operating cashflow negative RMB4.1577 million for the post-control reporting period.
objective_endowment_or_underuse_evidence: Gadlee develops, manufactures, sells and leases commercial floor scrubbers, sweepers and related cleaning equipment/chemicals, and also provides warehousing, distribution, training, maintenance and repair services.

The 2026 parent report describes a professional after-sales team, service points in more than 30 Chinese cities, 24-hour response and 48-hour on-site resolution, plus nationwide/international sales-service coverage.

Pre-control NEEQ employee disclosures provide a useful labor baseline rather than a current claim: 172 employees at 2023 year-end and 181 at 2024 half-year, with production, sales, technical, finance and administration staff.
observed_behavior_or_workaround_evidence: The buyer sought actual corporate control and integrated the target as a new cleaning-equipment growth line rather than buying a passive asset.
The post-control target continued producing material external revenue and accounting profit, but its own reported operating cash generation is negative in 2026 H1.
contradiction_or_partial_flow_evidence: This formation uses a target-level subsidiary table rather than attributing the parent's consolidated OCF to the target; the target-specific 2026 H1 OCF is negative RMB4.1577 million.
The combination cost exceeds RMB105 million and the target's 2026 H1 assets are about RMB188.08 million, so entry is not bounded small-operator capital.
The current operating description explicitly depends on a professional nationwide after-sales/service network, training, maintenance, repair, warehousing and distribution.
Historical employee counts are not treated as 2026 current FTE, but they reinforce that no explicit low-headcount transformation has been evidenced after control.
economic_signal: Acquisition cash consideration RMB76.3832 million; accounting combination cost RMB105.4082 million.
2026 H1 target-level revenue RMB52.9509 million and net profit RMB1.2366 million.
2026 H1 target-level operating cashflow negative RMB4.1577 million.
exact_incumbent_and_control_surface_pref: The acquired asset combines manufacturing, products, brand/channel and service organization rather than a narrow machine-callable software/control rail.
Digital/IoT and autonomous cleaning products improve product automation but do not eliminate the seller's professional after-sales, maintenance, training, distribution and manufacturing organization.
No evidence supports a founder-light small-operator takeover path at the current capital and service footprint.
